$meta.name: Shanky personal brand tokens
$meta.scope: personal repos, personal apps, dashboards, personal documents. KodeKloud client work keeps the KodeKloud system.
$meta.verification: every text pair listed here clears WCAG AA 4.5:1. Category colours are at least 25 apart (dE76) under simulated deuteranopia and protanopia. See accessibility-report.md.
rules: Category colour and status colour never occupy the same slot in one component. Category goes on the left edge, the mark, or the badge. Status goes in the right-hand chip and always carries a word.
Three category colours only. Making and 3D printing, forks, and the profile repo stay ink.
The mark identifies the project. The colour identifies the group.
Grain is the only permitted texture. No gradients as a full-bleed wash.
No italics, no emoji, no em dashes. Underlines appear in exactly one place: persistently under inline text links, which is an accessibility requirement (2026-08-19 decision), never as emphasis.

display.case: lowercase only, capitals map to the same shapes
display.coverage: a-z, 0-9, hyphen, period, comma, colon, slash, underscore, parentheses, space
display.use: wordmarks, banner headers, app titles, hero numbers. Never body text.

ui.rules: no italics; underlines only and always on inline text links

document.note: document chrome only, per your standing house rule

designedCollateral.note: supersedes spacing 1 for designed pages, not for plain documents

page.use: the page itself, app background, README band

card.use: any panel sitting on the page

raised.use: a panel inside a panel, hover state, table header

edgeStrong.use: strong DECORATIVE separation only (about 1.4 to 1.7:1). Never the only cue for a control or a state; that is controlBorder and stateIndicator (added 2026-08-19 after the external-critique audit).

controlBorder.use: input borders, control outlines, anything WCAG 1.4.11 says must be perceivable. Clears 3:1 on page, card and raised.

stateIndicator.use: selected-row rails, active-state markers, checked outlines. Pair with a non-colour cue (check, weight, icon) where the state carries meaning.

quiet.use: labels, captions, metadata. Never for a number you need.

brass.means: read a signal against a baseline

info.use: neutral notice, a link, a hint

focus.use: 2px ring, 2px offset, on every focusable element

labelOnFill.use: text placed on top of any category or status fill

link.use: inline text links, ALWAYS with a persistent underline (2026-08-19 decision). Info stays for chips and notices; link is its own token because Info misses 4.5:1 on raised.

card.use: any panel sitting on the page

raised.use: panel inside a panel, table header

edgeStrong.use: strong DECORATIVE separation only. Controls and states use controlBorder and stateIndicator.

controlBorder.use: input borders, control outlines. Clears 3:1 on page, card and raised.

stateIndicator.use: selected-row rails, active-state markers. Pair with a non-colour cue.

brass.means: read a signal against a baseline

labelOnFill.use: text on any category or status fill in light theme

link.use: inline text links, ALWAYS with a persistent underline. Same value as Info, which already clears 4.5:1 on every light surface.

shields.note: shields.io badges render white text, so badges always use the light-theme (deeper) values

githubLabels.note: GitHub label hex values, no leading hash. Same deeper values so the auto-chosen text colour stays white.

space.note: 12px is the floor between rows in any list. You named no air between rows as a real cost, so density is capped, not tuned.

forbidden: on top of any category or status fill

wordmark.accentDot: at most one letter may carry a filled dot in the project's category colour
wordmark.clearSpace: half the x-height of the wordmark on all four sides, measured from the ink
wordmark.colour: text primary of the active theme, never a category colour

marks.status: shipped 2026-08-18. All nine project marks are drawn as production geometry in design/marks/generate_marks.py with master, s24 and s16 variants, exported to the full matrix under design/marks/out/.

never: recolour the wordmark to a category colour
stretch, skew, rotate or outline it
place it on a mid-tone grey between #404040 and #A0A0A0
place it over grain above 0.2 opacity or over a photograph
ship a banner block in a repo before the artwork exists
